summary.definition: PASS means the observed later close matched the locked forecast direction. RISE > 0%, FALL < 0%; RANGE means within ±0.5% of the recorded starting close. All other settled outcomes are FAIL.
summary.horizonRule: A horizon is settled after the required number of NEW dated provider closing observations, not at a promised exact calendar time.
summary.warning: Past accuracy is not guaranteed future performance. Models are not trained on pending outcomes.

learning.note: Training requires at least 40 settled predictions per period. Uses earlier 70% to train and later 30% to test calibration. Only adjusts new forecasts if holdout Brier improves by at least 0.01.
learning.warning: Learning can reduce some historical error, but no improvement or future predictive skill is guaranteed.
